# Ubiquiti UniFi Pro Max 16 (USW-Pro-Max-16), 16-port managed switch

| Quantity | 1 |

Planned ports: 2.5GbE for Berserk's two I226-V ports and Kenshin's onboard port
(one spare), 1GbE for Berserk's BMC, one SFP+ to the home network. The 50GbE
Berserk-Kenshin link stays a direct QSFP28 DAC, not through the switch.
Mount it on the fixed rails, not the sliding shelf; leave enough patch-lead
slack to unplug the shelf end before sliding. Its 25 W adds to the cabinet heat
load. U position not chosen yet.

## Assembly

- **not in the assembly**: U position in the cabinet not chosen yet; 1U, half-width case 325.1 x 160 x 43.7 mm in the UACC-Pro-Max-16-RM kit
